_note: Hand-written. Three obvious complaint themes, each in English and in Hinglish, plus unrelated reviews as noise. Used to check that clustering recovers the themes and does not split them by language.

en: Payment failed but the money was deducted from my bank account.
My payment keeps failing and the amount is still debited.
Money got deducted twice for a single payment.
The transaction failed and I have not received my money back.
Paid through UPI, payment shows failed but the amount was debited.
Every payment I try fails and my account gets charged anyway.
Amount debited from my bank but the payment is shown as failed.
Payment failure again, the money is gone and nothing was settled.
The payment did not go through yet my bank shows the money deducted.
Transaction failed three times and the money was taken each time.
hinglish: payment fail ho gaya lekin paisa bank se kat gaya
paisa kat gaya aur payment fail dikha raha hai
ek payment ke liye do baar paisa kat gaya
transaction fail ho gaya aur paisa wapas nahi aaya
UPI se payment kiya, fail dikha raha hai lekin paise kat gaye
har baar payment fail hota hai aur account se paisa kat jata hai
bank se amount debit ho gaya par payment failed dikha raha hai
phir se payment fail, paisa bhi gaya aur settle bhi nahi hua
payment hua nahi lekin bank mein paisa kata hua dikha raha hai
teen baar transaction fail hua aur teeno baar paisa kat gaya

en: There are way too many ads in this app now.
A full screen ad pops up after every single tap.
Ads everywhere, I cannot use the app without watching videos.
Too many advertisements, it has become unusable.
I have to watch a video ad before adding each expense.
The ads are so frequent that the app is annoying to use.
Constant ads interrupt whatever I am doing in the app.
Every screen has a banner ad and a popup ad on top.
The number of ads has doubled since the last update.
Please reduce the ads, there is one after every action.
hinglish: is app mein ab bahut zyada ads aate hai
har tap ke baad full screen ad aa jata hai
har jagah ads hai, video dekhe bina app use nahi kar sakte
itne zyada advertisement hai ki app use karna mushkil hai
har expense add karne se pehle video ad dekhna padta hai
ads itne baar aate hai ki app se chidh ho gayi hai
kuch bhi karo beech mein ad aa jata hai
har screen pe banner ad aur upar se popup ad
pichle update ke baad ads double ho gaye hai
ads kam karo yaar, har kaam ke baad ek ad aata hai

en: I cannot log in because the OTP never arrives.
The verification code is not sent to my phone number.
Login is broken, I never receive the OTP message.
Waiting for the OTP for an hour, still cannot sign in.
The app logs me out and then the OTP does not come.
Cannot sign in, the one time password SMS never shows up.
OTP not received on my number so I am locked out of my account.
Sign in fails every time because no verification code is sent.
I requested the login OTP five times and got nothing.
Unable to log in to my account, the OTP SMS is never delivered.
hinglish: OTP aata hi nahi hai isliye login nahi ho raha
verification code mere number pe nahi aa raha
login nahi ho raha, OTP ka message aata hi nahi
ek ghante se OTP ka wait kar raha hu, sign in nahi ho raha
app logout kar deta hai aur phir OTP nahi aata
sign in nahi ho raha, OTP wala SMS aata hi nahi
mere number pe OTP nahi aaya, account mein ghus nahi pa raha
har baar sign in fail, verification code bheja hi nahi jata
paanch baar login OTP manga, ek baar bhi nahi aaya
account mein login nahi ho pa raha, OTP SMS deliver nahi hota

noise: The dark mode colours are hard on the eyes at night.
Please add a widget for the home screen.
The font size is too small on my tablet.
It would be nice to have a Tamil language option.
My flatmate left the group and the group name disappeared.
The app icon looks outdated compared to other apps.
Exported spreadsheet has the columns in a strange order.
Battery drains quickly when the app runs in the background.
currency conversion ka rate purana dikha raha hai
group ka photo change karne ka option nahi mil raha
